recurringSection.description: Try our vetted partners once. If you are satisfied with the results, unlock recurring schedules (weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly turnovers) to save 10% on future bookings.

faqSection.subtitle: FAQ
faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.q1: Do you do the cleaning yourselves?
faqSection.a1: No, Elite acts as a vetted brokerage layer. We manage bookings, quality audits, insurance, and payments, while dispatching the physical service to certified Swiss specialty subcontractors.
faqSection.a2: We are launching initial service dispatches in Zurich, Lake Zurich, and surrounding municipalities, planning expansion to further Swiss cantons in later phases.
faqSection.q3: What if something is damaged during a session?
faqSection.a3: All assigned subcontractors are vetted to carry liability insurance. In the rare event of damage, Elite mediates the claim and guarantees resolution through our platform pledge.
faqSection.a4: Yes. All application servers, Supabase instances, and logs are hosted in European datacenters. We do not track cookies without consent, and you can export or purge your account records at any time.
